spec.expr: changes(registrystats_image_last_pushed_timestamp_seconds{registry="ghcr",repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"}[1h]) > 0

spec.description: Download counts for your Docker Hub and GHCR images, grouped per package, with release, registry and tag views and the collector's own health. The counts are requests, not people or finished downloads, and on GHCR an automated manifest read counts too.

spec.title: Package overview
spec.description: Downloads per package over all time, the last 24 hours, 7 and 30 days, and per day over 30 days, where a registry that restates its total lower shows a drop. Docker Hub and GHCR are added together, or get a row each with Split by registry on. GHCR pushed counts every push, Hub updated is Docker Hub's update time, which a description edit also moves, and Hub tags and Untagged are Docker Hub's tag count and GHCR's untagged versions. Those counts can be up to 24 hours old at the default hourly check and fill in over the first day after a restart, see Collector health.

spec.expr: sum by (owner, repo${split}) (max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))
sum by (owner, repo${split}) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[1d:15m]))
sum by (owner, repo${split}) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[7d:1h]))
sum by (owner, repo${split}) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[30d:1h]))
sum by (owner, repo${split}) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[30d:1h])) / 30
max by (owner, repo${split}) (registrystats_image_last_pushed_timestamp_seconds{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}) * 1000

max by (owner, repo${split}) ((label_replace(registrystats_dockerhub_repository_updated_timestamp_seconds{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"}, "registry", "dockerhub", "", "") and on (registry) group by (registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))) * 1000

max by (owner, repo${split}) ((label_replace(registrystats_dockerhub_tags{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"}, "registry", "dockerhub", "", "") and on (registry) group by (registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"})))

max by (owner, repo${split}) ((label_replace(registrystats_ghcr_versions{state="untagged",repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"}, "registry", "ghcr", "", "") and on (registry) group by (registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"})))

spec.title: Cumulative downloads
spec.description: Each package's reported total over time, one line per package, or one per package and registry with Split by registry on. A steeper line means faster growth. A step down means a registry restated its count lower, which the shipped alert rules also flag.

spec.expr: sum by (owner, repo${split}) (max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))

spec.title: Downloads per day
spec.description: New downloads per day for each package, stacked, split per registry when Split by registry is on. Tall bars after a release are normal, and automated reads move these counts too, because a GHCR manifest read counts as a download. A bar below zero means a registry restated its total lower.

spec.expr: sum by (owner, repo${split}) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[1d:15m]))

spec.title: Total downloads
spec.description: Downloads added up across the selected packages and registries, as each registry reports them. These are request counts, not people or finished downloads. No packages tracked means no data has arrived for this selection.

spec.expr: sum(max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))

spec.title: Tracked packages
spec.description: How many packages registry-stats tracks for this selection. A package on both Docker Hub and GHCR counts once, or twice with Split by registry on, so the number matches the rows in Package overview. A drop means a package left your list or a registry stopped listing it.

spec.expr: count(sum by (owner, repo${split}) (max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"})))

spec.title: Downloads last 24 h
spec.description: Downloads across the selected packages and registries in the last 24 hours, with the trend over the dashboard range. These are request counts as each registry reports them, so automated reads count too. A value below zero means a registry restated its total lower. No downloads yet means no two counts a day apart exist for this selection.

spec.expr: sum(delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[1d:15m]))

spec.title: Against the 7-day average
spec.description: The last 24 hours' downloads against the daily average of the last 7 days, in percent. A large rise with no release behind it usually means an automated reader started polling. No average yet means the last 7 days hold no downloads to compare with.

spec.expr: (sum(delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[1d:15m])) / (sum(delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[7d:1h])) / 7 > 0) - 1) * 100

spec.title: Last 7 days
spec.description: Downloads in the last 7 days beside the 7 days before them, as each registry reports them. Compare the two to see whether demand rose or fell. A registry that restates its total lower reduces them. No downloads yet means the counts do not reach back that far.

spec.expr: sum(delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[7d:1h]))
sum(delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[7d:1h] offset 7d))

spec.title: Last 30 days
spec.description: Downloads in the last 30 days across the selected packages and registries, as each registry reports them. A registry that restates its total lower reduces this number, while Share and Downloads by registry count only growth. No downloads yet means the counts do not reach back 30 days.

spec.expr: sum(delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[30d:1h]))

spec.title: Data age
spec.description: Time since the selected registries were last read successfully, for the registry and collector read longest ago. registry-stats reads every hour by default and the colours assume it: green is under 120 minutes, yellow from 120 minutes and red from 360 minutes, which means reads are failing or a collector stopped. Not reported yet means no successful read has been published.

spec.expr: time() - min(registrystats_collect_last_success_timestamp_seconds{source=~"$registry"})

spec.title: Recent pushes
spec.description: The 10 GHCR packages pushed most recently, newest first, from the "Last published" time each package page shows. Every push moves it, signatures, attestations and branch tags included, so a push is not always a release. Docker Hub publishes no push time, so only GHCR packages are listed. No pushes yet means no package page stated a time.

spec.expr: topk(10, max by (owner, repo) (registrystats_image_last_pushed_timestamp_seconds{registry="ghcr",repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"})) * 1000

spec.title: Registries out of step
spec.description: Packages that one registry has and the other definitively does not at the last complete read, plus an Unknown row when a read was stale or incomplete, a collector stopped reporting, or none reports. Packages pair by owner and name, and a GHCR name with a slash in it is never compared, because Docker Hub cannot hold one. With owner/* on both registries, a package you publish to one on purpose stays listed while your configuration covers it. A read counts as stale after 2 hours, which assumes the default hourly check, and No package missing means every read was fresh and complete, which a collector that reads one registry also shows.

spec.expr: (label_replace((max by (job, instance, owner, repo) (registrystats_image_present{source="ghcr",repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"}) == 1) and on (job, instance, owner, repo) (max by (job, instance, owner, repo) (registrystats_image_present{source="dockerhub",repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"}) == 0) and on (job, instance) (max by (job, instance) (registrystats_collect_complete{source="dockerhub"}) == 1) and on (job, instance) (count by (job, instance) (max by (job, instance, source) (time() - registrystats_collect_last_success_timestamp_seconds < 7200)) == count by (job, instance) (max by (job, instance, source) (registrystats_collect_complete))), "status", "Not on Docker Hub now", "", "")) or (label_replace((max by (job, instance, owner, repo) (registrystats_image_present{source="dockerhub",repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"}) == 1) and on (job, instance, owner, repo) (max by (job, instance, owner, repo) (registrystats_image_present{source="ghcr",repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"}) == 0) and on (job, instance) (max by (job, instance) (registrystats_collect_complete{source="ghcr"}) == 1) and on (job, instance) (count by (job, instance) (max by (job, instance, source) (time() - registrystats_collect_last_success_timestamp_seconds < 7200)) == count by (job, instance) (max by (job, instance, source) (registrystats_collect_complete))), "status", "Not on GHCR now", "", "")) or (label_replace(group by (job, instance) (registrystats_collect_complete), "status", "Unknown: a registry read was stale or incomplete, see Collector health", "", "") unless on (job, instance) ((count by (job, instance) (max by (job, instance, source) (time() - registrystats_collect_last_success_timestamp_seconds < 7200)) == count by (job, instance) (max by (job, instance, source) (registrystats_collect_complete))) and on (job, instance) (min by (job, instance) (registrystats_collect_complete) == 1))) or (label_replace(group by (job, instance) (present_over_time(registrystats_collect_complete[7d])) unless on (job, instance) group by (job, instance) (registrystats_collect_complete), "status", "Unknown: this collector stopped reporting, see Collector health", "", "")) or (label_replace(vector(1), "status", "Unknown: registry-stats is not reporting, see Collector health", "", "") unless on () count(group by (job, instance) (present_over_time(registrystats_collect_complete[7d]))))

defaults.noValue: No package missing from a registry at the last check

spec.title: Images nobody pulled in 30 days
spec.description: Packages whose count did not change at all over the last 30 days, with their total, one row per package or per package and registry with Split by registry on. A package here has no readers, not even automated ones, so it may be one to retire, while a count a registry restated lower is a change and keeps its package off the list. A package appears only after every registry it is on has reported it for the full 30 days.

spec.expr: sum by (owner, repo${split}) (max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"})) and on (owner, repo${split}) (sum by (owner, repo${split}) (changes((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[30d:1h])) == 0) unless on (owner, repo${split}) (max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}) unless on (owner, repo, registry) max by (owner, repo, registry) (max_over_time(registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}[1d] offset 30d)))

defaults.noValue: Every package was downloaded in the last 30 days

spec.title: Downloads per day by registry
spec.description: New downloads per day on each registry, stacked, with the sum over the range in the legend. A jump on one registry alone points at an automated reader or a release that reached one registry first. A bar below zero means a registry restated its total lower.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(sum by (registry) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[1d:15m])), "name", "Docker Hub", "registry", "dockerhub"), "name", "GHCR", "registry", "ghcr")

spec.title: Movers this week
spec.description: The 5 packages whose downloads grew most and the 5 that fell most, comparing the last 7 days with the 7 days before. GHCR counts every manifest read, so automated polling moves these numbers as much as people do, and a mover rarely needs an action. A package without counts in both weeks is not listed.

spec.expr: topk(5, sum by (owner, repo${split}) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[7d:1h])) - sum by (owner, repo${split}) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[7d:1h] offset 7d))) or bottomk(5, sum by (owner, repo${split}) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[7d:1h])) - sum by (owner, repo${split}) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[7d:1h] offset 7d)))

defaults.noValue: No two weeks of counts yet

spec.title: Share of downloads last 30 days
spec.description: The 15 packages with the largest share of all downloads in the last 30 days, in percent of the selection. One package far ahead of the rest is often polled by automation rather than pulled by people, and a count a registry restated lower adds nothing. No downloads yet means the counts do not reach back 30 days.

spec.expr: topk(15, sum by (owner, repo${split}) (clamp_min(delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[30d:1h]), 0))) / on () group_left () (sum(clamp_min(delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[30d:1h]), 0)) > 0) * 100

spec.title: Downloads per week by registry
spec.description: New downloads per week on each registry over the last year, stacked, with the sum in the legend. Use it to see the long trend that daily bars hide. A bar below zero means a registry restated its total lower.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(sum by (registry) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[7d:1h])), "name", "Docker Hub", "registry", "dockerhub"), "name", "GHCR", "registry", "ghcr")

spec.title: 30-day rolling average per package
spec.description: Average downloads per day over the 30 days before each point, over the last year, one line per package or per package and registry with Split by registry on. A line that climbs steadily is growing use, and a sudden step that holds is usually a new automated reader. A registry that restates its total lower pulls the line down for the next 30 days.

spec.expr: sum by (owner, repo${split}) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[30d:1h])) / 30

spec.title: Downloads by registry, last 30 days
spec.description: Downloads on each registry in the last 30 days across the selected packages. GHCR counts every manifest read and Docker Hub counts its own pulls, so the two are not the same measure. A package whose count a registry restated lower adds nothing, and No downloads yet means the counts do not reach back 30 days.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(sum by (registry) (clamp_min(delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}))[30d:1h]), 0)), "name", "Docker Hub", "registry", "dockerhub"), "name", "GHCR", "registry", "ghcr")

spec.title: GHCR against Docker Hub per image
spec.description: Each image's downloads on both registries over the last 30 days, and how many GHCR downloads it gets per Docker Hub download. Most images sit close together, and one far above the rest is usually read by an automated tool on GHCR rather than pulled by people. An image on one registry only has no ratio. A registry that restates its total lower reduces that total and can make the ratio negative.

spec.expr: sum by (owner, repo) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{registry="ghcr",repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"}))[30d:1h]))
sum by (owner, repo) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{registry="dockerhub",repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"}))[30d:1h]))

sum by (owner, repo) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{registry="ghcr",repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"}))[30d:1h])) / (sum by (owner, repo) (delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{registry="dockerhub",repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"}))[30d:1h])) > 0)

spec.title: Tags and versions per image
spec.description: Hub tags is each image's tag count on Docker Hub, and Tagged and Untagged are its version counts on GHCR. Signatures and attestations count as GHCR versions, and some readers fetch every tag, so a growing count can raise the download numbers. The counts can be up to 24 hours old at the default hourly check and fill in over the first day after a restart, see Collector health.

spec.expr: max by (owner, repo) (registrystats_dockerhub_tags{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"})
max by (owner, repo) (registrystats_ghcr_versions{state="tagged",repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"})
max by (owner, repo) (registrystats_ghcr_versions{state="untagged",repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner"})

spec.title: Downloads per day against tag count
spec.description: Downloads per day for the image picked in Image, as bars per registry, with its Docker Hub tag count and GHCR tagged version count as lines on the right axis. Downloads that rise in step with the tag count point at a reader that fetches every tag rather than at people pulling the image. Pick an image to fill the chart. A bar below zero means a registry restated its total lower.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(sum by (registry) ((label_join(delta((max by (owner, repo, registry) (registrystats_image_pulls_total{registry=~"$registry"}))[1d:15m]), "image", "/", "owner", "repo") * on (image) group_left () label_replace(vector(1), "image", "$image", "", ""))), "name", "Docker Hub", "registry", "dockerhub"), "name", "GHCR", "registry", "ghcr")
max((label_join(registrystats_dockerhub_tags, "image", "/", "owner", "repo") * on (image) group_left () label_replace(vector(1), "image", "$image", "", "")))
max((label_join(registrystats_ghcr_versions{state="tagged"}, "image", "/", "owner", "repo") * on (image) group_left () label_replace(vector(1), "image", "$image", "", "")))

spec.title: Data age per registry
spec.description: Time since each registry was last read successfully, for the selected collector read longest ago, while Tag and version data age covers the tag columns. Green is under 120 minutes, yellow from 120 minutes and red from 360 minutes, which assumes the default hourly check, and red means reads of that registry are failing. Not reported yet means no successful read has been published.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(time() - min by (source) (registrystats_collect_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job"}), "name", "Docker Hub", "source", "dockerhub"), "name", "GHCR", "source", "ghcr")

spec.title: Last read complete per registry
spec.description: Whether every listing and package read of the last check came back with an answer, per registry, for the selected collector that did worst. Green Complete means nothing was left unknown. Yellow Incomplete means a listing was cut short or failed, or some package could not be read, so Registries out of step shows Unknown and the container log names the cause. Not reported yet means no check has finished.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(min by (source) (registrystats_collect_complete{job=~"$job"}), "name", "Docker Hub", "source", "dockerhub"), "name", "GHCR", "source", "ghcr")

spec.title: Tag and version data age
spec.description: Age of the oldest tag or version count on show, per registry, across the selected collectors. Counts are read again when an image is pushed or once they are 24 hours old, and a cold start spreads the first reads over a day. Green is up to 1560 minutes, which is 26 hours at the default hourly check, and yellow beyond, which means reads keep failing or a rate limit stopped them. No counts read yet means none has been read since the start.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(time() - min by (source) (registrystats_details_oldest_read_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job"}), "name", "Docker Hub", "source", "dockerhub"), "name", "GHCR", "source", "ghcr")

spec.title: Images without detail series
spec.description: Images past the 250 owner/repo names registry-stats details, which get downloads but no push time, presence, tag or version counts. Names are taken in alphabetical order, so the last ones miss out, and listing fewer images brings them back. The value is the selected collector with the most, and green is none and yellow is 1 or more. Not reported yet means no check has finished.

spec.expr: max(sum by (job, instance) (max by (job, instance, source) (registrystats_image_details_omitted{job=~"$job"})))

spec.title: Checks and failed checks per day
spec.description: Checks per day for each registry as lines, added up across the selected collectors, and the checks that failed as red and orange bars. A failed check lost a whole listing or most of its package reads. At the default hourly interval a day holds 24 checks per collector, and any failed bar is worth a look at the container log. No bars means no check finished in the range.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(sum by (source) (max by (job, instance, source) (increase(registrystats_collects_total{job=~"$job"}[1d]))), "name", "Docker Hub", "source", "dockerhub"), "name", "GHCR", "source", "ghcr")

label_replace(label_replace(sum by (source) (max by (job, instance, source) (increase(registrystats_collect_errors_total{job=~"$job"}[1d]))), "name", "Docker Hub", "source", "dockerhub"), "name", "GHCR", "source", "ghcr")

spec.title: Check duration
spec.description: How long a full check of both registries takes, tag and version reads included, as the median and the 95th percentile over the day before each point. GHCR pages are spaced 2 to 5 seconds apart and Docker Hub requests half a second apart, so the time grows with the number of images. A climb with no new images means slower or retried requests.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (increase(registrystats_collect_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[1d])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(registrystats_collect_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[1d])))

spec.title: Counts that went down
spec.description: Packages whose count is below its highest value of the last 2 days, with how far it fell. A registry restating its total, or a page read that returned a wrong number, causes this, and the shipped alert RegistryStatsPullCountRegressed fires on it too. No count went down means every count kept its high.

spec.expr: max by (owner, repo, registry) (max_over_time(registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}[2d]) - registrystats_image_pulls_total{repo=~"$repo",owner=~"$owner",registry=~"$registry"}) > 0

defaults.noValue: No count went down in the last 2 days

spec.title: Exporter up
spec.description: Whether your Prometheus server could scrape registry-stats at its last scrape. Green Up is healthy, red Down means the target is unreachable. Not scraped means no scrape target matches the selected job.

spec.expr: max by (instance) (up{job=~"$job"})

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Time since the registry-stats process started. A short uptime after a crash or a deploy is expected, and one that keeps resetting means the container restarts. Not scraped means no process metrics arrived.

spec.expr: time() - max(process_start_time_seconds{job=~"$job"})

spec.title: Restarts in this range
spec.description: How many times a registry-stats process started again within the dashboard range, added up across the selected collectors. Green is none and yellow is 1 or more, and a count that grows without deploys means the container keeps restarting. Not scraped means no process metrics arrived.

spec.expr: sum(max by (job, instance) (changes(process_start_time_seconds{job=~"$job"}[$__range])))

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: Resident memory of the registry-stats process, with the trend over the range. It grows with the number of images tracked and stays flat between checks, so a steady climb across days points at a leak. Not scraped means no process metrics arrived.

spec.expr: max(process_resident_memory_bytes{job=~"$job"})
